_comment: Ground truth read off an in-game 'Stoke City / Club Fixtures' screenshot, 2026-09-20.
Stoke City is NOT a club either career manages -- it never appears in mart.club_matches
for either Frem or Bucaspor, so PR #63's own ground truth (282/285 rows, both careers)
never exercised this club's records at all. This file is the first independent check of
fix_man.dat against a club neither career has any reason to touch, which is a stronger
claim than 'it works for our own fixtures'.
tid values were resolved once via fmparser.reference._build_refdata_index and confirmed
by name (Wigan Athletic, Peterborough United, Nottingham Forest, Bristol City,
Wolverhampton Wanderers, Swansea City, Coventry City, Millwall, Portsmouth, Crystal
home/away follow the screenshot's H/A column; the score is read literally as printed
(home team's goals first), which is what fix_man.dat's home-first ordering predicts.
The last two rows are the two legs of the Championship playoff semi-final -- included on
purpose, since a two-legged tie is the case most likely to break the 'plain shape' score
block save-archive.md warns is not fully understood.
